description: This file contains utility functions for handling Android boot images, including packing/unpacking ramdisks, creating boot images, and extracting Android version info from boot images. It interacts with various external tools and libraries to manipulate boot images and ramdisks, and includes functions for vendor-specific boot image handling.

methods.name: RunMkBootFs
methods.description: Creates a cpio archive from a directory and writes it to an output file using mkbootfs.

methods.name: RunLz4
methods.description: Compresses a file using lz4 and writes the output to a specified file.

methods.name: ExtractValue
methods.description: Extracts a value associated with a key from a string dictionary.

methods.name: DeleteTmpFileIfNotChanged
methods.description: Deletes a temporary file if it hasn't changed compared to the current file, to avoid unnecessary overwrites.

methods.name: RepackVendorRamdisk
methods.description: Recreates a vendor ramdisk by unpacking, stripping modules, and concatenating ramdisk parts.
